_doc: Settings hooks for change hypotheses (robot/overlay.py, robot/gen/changes.py). Values that map to ops are pure spec overlays; env hooks are build-time settings the robust runner applies as choice edits. Anchors are named locations a part can be added at. Owners map build files to the fixer that owns them.

top_deck_rear._why: standing on the Ti top panel (top z 20.4) behind the switch

rear_outside._why: behind the tub rear face (y -37.6), between the rear wheels

tub_interior_rear._why: inside the tub between the N10s on the rear axle line

chassis.compartments._why: declared compartment layout (params_chassis.COMPARTMENTS): standard = motor pockets + stop wall/key tab/ledge and the pack bay cut from the catalog envelope; none = no compartment features; split_battery_bay = standard plus a rib between the pack bay and the electronics bay

drive.location._why: drive axle line (params_chassis.DRIVE_LOCATIONS -> RY): the tub's keyhole, key tab, stop wall, pad recess, motor pocket, the pack bay and the rig's n10/wheel_face joints follow it; side panels, forks, hubs and belts (owner C) and the rear-only tub structure do not yet

drive.motor._why: catalog id of the drive gearmotor (params_chassis.DRIVE_MOTOR); the tub pockets, MOTX, key tab, stop wall, pad and rig joints are derived from it

battery.pack._why: catalog id of the pack (params_hardware.BATTERY); the bay is cut from its envelope, it stands against the stop wall and the deck

drive.esc._why: catalog id of the receiver / drive ESC (params_chassis.RXESC); its bay is cut from the envelope

weapon.esc._why: catalog id of the weapon ESC (params_chassis.WESC); its bay is cut from the envelope

sizes._doc: Overall-size masters. `param` = a single master literal the sweep scales; `proxy` = the closest single literal when no master exists (the change is then also reported as missing hook size.<dim>).

length.why: length is CH_Y1 - CH_Y0 plus RY (rear axle), SA/SB (front standoffs) and WY (weapon): no single master

height.why: height is CH_Z1 - CH_Z0 with WZ, SA[1], SB[1] and the top panel set separately: no single master
